data.name: GET COOKED
data.detailed_description:
COMING SOON - WISHLIST NOW!

The grills are heating up. The walls are going up.

GET COOKED is in the final stretch of development. Wishlist now to get notified the moment the doors open!

Add it to your wishlist and be first in line on launch day.


About the Game

Run the restaurant. Then defend it with your life.

GET COOKED is a multiplayer game where two rival restaurants share one city — and only one team walks away the winner. Cook, sell, and build up your base while the clock ticks down… because when the war siren sounds, the fences drop and your rivals are coming for everything you built.

⏱ PREP — Build Your Empire

The match opens with a peaceful prep phase inside your own protected zone:

  • Cook and serve — grill patties, stack orders, and serve a stream of hungry customers. Every sale earns cash AND score. Chain sales for up to a ×5 combo.

  • Hire staff — put a chef on the grill so you can focus on the bigger picture.

  • Fortify — spend your earnings on walls, reinforced doors, turrets, mines, and defenses. Layer them well: your kitchen is your economy, and your economy is your win condition.

  • Order supplies— manage ingredient stock, call in deliveries, and keep the fryers running.

⚔️ WAR — Take What's Theirs

When war begins, the safe zones vanish and the city becomes a battlefield:

  • Raid the rival restaurant — ram their walls with vehicles, breach with explosives, or climb over with ladders.

  • Crack their vault — every restaurant guards a vault of stolen-able cash. Drain it fully for a massive heist bonus.

  • Wreck their dining room — destroy occupied tables to cut their income and bank points for yourself.

  • Keep cooking under fire — the kitchen never closes. Defending teams can still sell food mid-siege, and every sale still scores.

🔑 Key Features

  • 3v3 online multiplayer — team up with a friend against a rival duo

  • Two phases, one match: peaceful restaurant sim melts into all-out base war

  • Deep build system — walls, upgrades, turrets, mines, traps, and siege tools

  • Vehicles: ram raids, getaway drives, and an RC car for the sneaky

  • Vault heists with a one-time jackpot for a full clean-out

  • Solo Training mode to learn the ropes before going online

  • Proximity voice chat — talk trash through the wall you're about to break

data.short_description: A multiplayer game where rival teams each run a restaurant. Cook, serve customers, and fortify your base during prep — then wage war: ram walls with vehicles, crack the enemy vault, and wreck their dining room. First team to the target score wins.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 4GB / AMD RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8192 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Online multiplayer required for full experience. 1080p / Low preset targeting 30 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8192 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1440p / High preset. Hosting a 4-player match is CPU-heavy — host machine should meet or exceed this.

content_descriptors.notes:
GET COOKED is a competitive multiplayer game where teams run rival restaurants and then raid each other.

Violence: Players use conventional weapons (pistol, knife, grenades, explosives) and vehicles against other players and computer-controlled
characters. Deaths show red blood effects and ragdoll bodies. There is no dismemberment, mutilation, torture, or lingering depiction of death.
Players always respawn — no one is permanently eliminated.

Non-combatant characters (restaurant customers and staff) can be caught
in combat. They react with fear and flee.

Crime: A core objective is breaking into the rival team's restaurant to rob their vault and steal their food stock.
